'''Duck Mayonnaise''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made by placing a [[Duck Egg]] into a [[Mayonnaise Machine]], taking 3 hours.

==Bundles==
Duck Mayonnaise is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Duck Mayonnaise is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Duck Mayonnaise is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create an {{Name|Shirt009|link=Tailoring{{!}}Aquamarine Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a white dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Duck Mayonnaise is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].

==Secrets==
If Duck Mayonnaise is placed in the partially-hidden purple box in the back room of the [[The Stardrop Saloon]], the player will receive the [[File:??Pinky Lemon??.png|16px]] [[??Pinky Lemon??]] statue.
